result.reason: The operative language removes the prohibited three-year irrevocable take-or-pay commitment and limits any future minimum to a signed Order Form, the then-current 12-month term, a 30-day reduction right, and a true-up rather than a penalty. These changes are appropriately confined to the minimum-commitment issue and preserve the ability to agree to compliant commitments. Drafting is professional, though the true-up mechanics and meaning of “applicable unit price” could be specified more clearly, and the final sentence is somewhat cumbersome.
